units.source_text: "你看看这封信吧，校方又寄来了严厉的警告。

en.t: Take a look at this letter; the school has sent another stern warning.

units.source_text: 令首在天之灵有知的话，不知道会多伤心啊。

en.t: If your late father knew of this in the next world, who can say how heartbroken he would be?

units.source_text: 你自己也应该好好考虑，这样下去结果会成为什么样子呢？"……然后，他接着说了那一句：

en.t: You yourself ought to think carefully about what will become of you if things go on like this." ... Then he went on to say those words:

units.source_text: "我曾经打算让你接我的班，不过现在我必须明确地告诉你，

en.t: "I once intended to have you succeed me, but now I must tell you plainly,

units.source_text: 我已经没有这个意思了。"

en.t: I no longer have any such intention."
